exigences_sol: The guide provides recommendations for the cultivation of date palms, including the selection of suitable species, soil preparation, and irrigation methods.
besoins_hydriques: The palm tree requires adequate water supply, with the optimal amount varying depending on the soil type and climate. The recommended water supply is between 9 and 15 kg/hm2/year.

recommandations.description: Regular monitoring of soil moisture and temperature, and timely application of copper-based fungicides to prevent Phytophthora infections.
